name: aicamera-microservices
description: AI Camera Microservices Application with NestJS and Vue.js

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../../database && npm install && cd ../services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../mqtt-service && npm install && cd ../websocket-service && npm install && cd ../file-service && npm install && cd ../../dashboard && npm install && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api-gateway" "npm run dev:mqtt" "npm run dev:websocket" "npm run dev:file" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:services && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.build:services: cd services/api-gateway && npm run build && cd ../mqtt-service && npm run build && cd ../websocket-service && npm run build && cd ../file-service && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:api-gateway" "npm run start:mqtt" "npm run start:websocket" "npm run start:file"
scripts.db:migrate: cd database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd database && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.test: echo "Running tests for all services..." && cd services/api-gateway && npm test && cd ../mqtt-service && npm test && cd ../websocket-service && npm test && cd ../file-service && npm test
scripts.lint: echo "Linting all services..." && cd services/api-gateway && npm run lint && cd ../mqtt-service && npm run lint && cd ../websocket-service && npm run lint && cd ../file-service && npm run lint && cd ../../dashboard && npm run lint
scripts.format: echo "Formatting all services..." && cd services/api-gateway && npm run format && cd ../mqtt-service && npm run format && cd ../websocket-service && npm run format && cd ../file-service && npm run format

author: AI Camera Team
